technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (volume spike, CMF cross, force index) and trend-following indicators (supertrend, hull) show bullish structure, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud with weak ADX, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: HIG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 90 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; junior member mixed trades (2 sales, 1 purchase) in small amounts; broad market fear (42 score) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (335), flat yield curve with recession signals, and FOMC event just passed create severely adverse macro conditions for financials; 90-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), CMF/force index crosses, supertrend/hull bullish structure, and RSI-9 momentum create short-term technical setup with price near support (57.48) in fear-zone contrarian context.
